title: [Prime] Brother MFC-L2820DW Wireless Mono Laser Multi-Function $209.95 (RRP $309) Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: [Prime] Brother MFC-L2820DW Wireless Mono Laser Multi-Function $209.95 (RRP $309) Delivered @ Amazon AU

[Whodis] Watch out for brother auto updates now. They brick all the 3rd party toners on the regular.
[camshandez] That sad to hear :( I've loved my current brother mono laser printer for many years.
This article says Brother doesn't intentionally block 3rd party toners but whether or not the firmware has a side effect of not communicating with non brother toner chips is a possibility.
Have you seen recent examples of toners being blocked?
[Whodis] My workplace had a brother colour mfc and it bricked the 3rd party toners after an update.
I had one as well but the print quality was rather awful for images so I binned it and swapped it for an epson ecotank, no regretsx
[wongyyyy] i use 3rd party toners and i dont think mine ever auto updates, it should be all g
[Lps] ATL!!!
Well, almost… https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/857470
[bcYield] Supplies also on sale on Amazon. I just got the colour version coming with a set of cartridges costing more than the printer itself. Interesting!
[RoboRat] If you need ADF scanning, buy the L2880DW instead
https://amzn.asia/d/08db3azy
[lambsie] Potential price beat at OW?
https://www.officeworks.com.au/shop/officeworks/p/brother-mf…
[Faulty] Good deal OP!
If one can stretch the budget, the ADF duplex scanning in the MFC L2880DW is 100% worth the $43 premium over this one, over the lifetime of the printer. I scan duplex on the regular on my 2880DW, and it’s worth not having to sit there and manually flip each side.
[Mortin] I thin mine started duplex printing jamming after firmware update
